method: Independent cell occupancy/rays; DAG/reduction; five exact-legality order policies plus seeded random-free orders. No runtime/generator imports or content writes.
limits: No human participants, subjective ratings or retention measurement.
Bots know exact legality and make no recognition or touch errors. max_unlock is an omniscient upper-bound comparator.
Counts/depth/structural signatures are not human difficulty or enjoyment.
All legal orders need exactly one accepted removal per arrow; order policies can change search/travel/frontier rhythm, never move count.
traceOutput: Generated separately with --traces-output; default .test-output/gameplay-audit-traces.json (not a production asset).
